title: Putnami authored feature document
$comment: One feature of a root that holds features/<feature>.json instead of putnami.features.json. The reader merges every document of the directory into one manifest. The filename takes no part in identity; name it after the local part of the feature id.

protocolVersion.$comment: The manifest versions. Readers require an exact JSON integer token, 1, 2 or 3; 1.0 and 1e0 are invalid. Only version 2 or later may carry a requirement verification criterion or a feature surface. Only version 3 may carry an external spec reference.

allOf.$comment: A version 1 or 2 document cannot carry the version 3 external spec reference.
A version 1 document cannot carry the version 2 verification criterion or feature surface.
